title: SecOps-NG Supply-Chain Drift Record (SKELETON)
description: Typed shape for one drift record produced when the supply-chain drift detector diffs two successive `dependencies-snapshot.json` artefacts in the same `workflow_id` series. SKELETON in this card: the field inventory is pinned, but no detector implementation is shipped and no per-target compiler hook is wired — those land in the F-CP-03 EXTEND-drift CORE-FANOUT sibling. The four delta kinds (`added`, `removed`, `version_bumped`, `sovereignty_band_changed`) are the surface NIS2 Article 21(2)(d) periodic re-attestation cares about, and the per-entity record is the shape NIS2 Article 22 Cooperation-Group coordinated risk assessments aggregate against (the framework emits the per-entity drift record, not the Member-State aggregation envelope). Public-bar artefact: provider identifiers are opaque operator-side ids, free-text notes stay role-shaped or URN-shaped, and individual personal names are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Lets a consumer reject drift records produced under an older schema once breaking changes ship.

id.description: Stable per-record identifier. Convention: SHA-256 hex digest of `<workflow_id>|<previous_snapshot_ref>|<current_snapshot_ref>` (UTF-8, no separators around the pipes). Two detector runs against the same snapshot pair collide deliberately.

stream.description: Identifies which evidence stream produced the drift record. Constant on this schema.

workflow_id.description: Stable workflow identifier — one of the workflow ids declared under `content/playbooks/<workflow-id>/`. The drift record always pins to a single workflow series; cross-workflow drift is intentionally out of scope.

previous_snapshot_ref.description: `artifact_id` of the prior `dependencies-snapshot.json` artefact in this `workflow_id` series. SHA-256 hex digest (64 chars).

current_snapshot_ref.description: `artifact_id` of the current `dependencies-snapshot.json` artefact being compared against `previous_snapshot_ref`. SHA-256 hex digest (64 chars). MUST differ from `previous_snapshot_ref` — a drift record against an identical pair is not a drift record.

deltas.description: One entry per detected change between the two snapshots. An empty array is permitted: a deterministic detector that runs against a stable pair and finds no drift still produces a record so downstream consumers see the cadence walk happened (cf. `attestation_state` cadence discipline on the risk-analysis stream).

detected_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the detector resolved this snapshot pair. Format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (no sub-second precision, no offset — UTC only). Carries through to drift-aggregate rollups in the EXTEND-metrics sibling.

kind.description: Which drift surface this delta belongs to. The four-element vocabulary mirrors the surfaces NIS2 Art. 21(2)(d) periodic re-attestation cares about and is promoted into `schemas/supply_chain_drift_kind.json` alongside the detector wiring. Extending the set is a discussion, not a drive-by change.

provider_id.description: Stable internal id of the provider the delta is about (mirror of `dependencies[].provider_id` on the snapshot schema). Opaque operator-side id; the framework never resolves it.

previous.description: Minimal snapshot of the fields relevant to `kind` on the previous side of the change. `null` for `added`. Carries `{ version }` for `version_bumped` and `{ sovereignty_band }` for `sovereignty_band_changed`; carries the full dependency record's identifying triple `{ kind, version, sovereignty_band }` for `removed` so a downstream rollup can reconstruct what disappeared.

kind.description: Dependency kind on the previous side; one of the values promoted in `schemas/supply_chain_dependency_kind.json`.

version.description: Version pin or commit SHA on the previous side; `null` for moving-tag hosted services. Mirror of `dependencies[].version` on the snapshot schema.

sovereignty_band.description: Rolled-up sovereignty verdict on the previous side; one of the values promoted in `schemas/sovereignty_band.json`.

current.description: Minimal snapshot of the fields relevant to `kind` on the current side of the change. `null` for `removed`. Carries `{ kind, version, sovereignty_band }` for `added` so a downstream rollup sees what appeared; `{ version }` for `version_bumped`; `{ sovereignty_band }` for `sovereignty_band_changed`.

kind.description: Dependency kind on the current side; one of the values promoted in `schemas/supply_chain_dependency_kind.json`.

version.description: Version pin or commit SHA on the current side; `null` for moving-tag hosted services. Mirror of `dependencies[].version` on the snapshot schema.

sovereignty_band.description: Rolled-up sovereignty verdict on the current side; one of the values promoted in `schemas/sovereignty_band.json`.

note.description: Short free-text rationale field pinning the delta to its inputs. Read by reviewers; not parsed downstream. No individual contact names; provider identity only, mirroring the SCHEMA.md `risk_notes` discipline.
